name: Metadata Enrichment Agent
description: Assigns controlled-vocabulary metadata to incoming news at ingest. Deterministic entity + dedup layer, LLM enrichment, then a taxonomy conformance guard that blocks hallucinated codes and ungrounded evidence. Routes to auto-publish, editor review, or spec

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 2500, messages: [ { role: "user", content: $json.prompt } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## 1 - Ingest and dedup

The controlled vocabulary is read from a data table, not hardcoded. A taxonomist adds or retires a code there and the next run honours it, with no deployment.

Near-duplicate detection runs here, before any model call. Wire copy is republished verbatim across outlets; the canonical version is the lowest source tier, and the rest are suppressed rather than tagged twice.

## 2 - Deterministic first

Company candidates are matched against the authority file with word boundaries and a common-noun guard, so "shell companies" never resolves to Shell plc.

The model is given only the candidates the gazetteer found. It decides which are central to the story and which are passing mentions. It cannot introduce a company that is not in the authority file.

## 3 - The guard is the point

Every proposed code is checked against the vocabulary before it can enter the index:

- not in the vocabulary, rejected
- wrong facet, rejected
- evidence span not found verbatim in the article, rejected
- retired code, remapped to its successor
- below the confidence floor, rejected

A fabricated justification is caught deterministically, for free, without a second model call. Nothing the model returns is trusted on its own authority.

## 4 - Measured, not asserted

24 records carry an editor-assigned key through the pipeline.

The headline number is not accuracy. It is the count of records that auto-published with a tag error - the only errors with no human in front of them. Straight-through rate is meaningless without it.

Review queue precision is tracked too: a queue full of records a human would not have changed teaches editors to click through, and then the gate protects nothing.

parameters.content:
## 5 - The brief writes itself

The scorecard is numbers. This branch is what they mean, as a Word document a director can read without opening n8n.

Same separation of duties as the tagging path: deterministic code extracts every figure and renders every table. The model is handed those figures and nothing else, and is explicitly forbidden from introducing numbers of its own.

If the narrative call fails, the document still ships with all figures intact and says on its face that the prose is missing. It did exactly that on the first run, when reasoning tokens ate the output budget.
